description: This file defines interfaces for the IOcdm and IOcdmFactory classes, which are part of the Rialto media server component. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and external dependencies related to DRM system support.

classes.name: IOcdm
classes.description: Interface for interacting with a DRM system, providing a method to check if a specific key system is supported.

classes.name: IOcdmFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and retrieving singleton instances of IOcdm.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Static method to create and retrieve a shared pointer to an IOcdmFactory instance.

methods.name: getOcdm
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to an IOcdm instance, representing the singleton DRM object.

methods.name: isTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if the specified key system is supported by the DRM system.
